title: Coral microbiomes across depths and protected areas
description: 16S rRNA sequencing associated with the study of Endozoicomonas in hard and soft corals around Little Cayman. Run-level files are linked through ENA, with NCBI project and run accessions retained.

title: Microbiomes of nursery-reared Acropora cervicornis
description: Sample metadata, ASV and taxonomy tables, R analysis scripts, and archived sequence reads for the study of microbiome variation among nursery coral colonies and genotypes.

title: Genotype-specific responses after coral outplanting
description: Coral photophysiology, growth and symbiont-density files with R Markdown analysis for the fate-tracking study of outplanted Acropora cervicornis.

title: Nursery coral genotypes during the 2023 heatwave
description: Nursery coral-health and genotype observations, temperature records, NOAA heat-stress inputs and analysis code associated with the 2023 marine heatwave.

title: Mesophotic thermal refuge during the 2023 bleaching event
description: Coral bleaching surveys along a 10–50 m depth gradient, temperature measurements and analysis code. The repository describes surveys on 16 September 2023 in Bloody Bay Marine Park.

title: Little Cayman bleaching and mortality, 2023–2024
description: Coral bleaching-prevalence and transect data, together with a Little Cayman weekly degree-heating-week series covering 1985–2023. Version DOI 15057987 is retained separately from concept DOI 15057986.

title: Irradiance-driven trophic plasticity in Madracis pharensis
description: Photophysiology, skeletal morphology and symbiont data with analysis code for corals growing in different orientations on a shipwreck at 30 m in the Bay of Haifa. The repository uses an earlier study title.

title: Light and photoacclimatization across reef depths
description: Coral photophysiology, functional-group and colony-size data, light observations and R Markdown analysis associated with shallow–mesophotic community comparisons.

title: Genotype mixtures and nursery disease resistance
description: Colony-level white-band disease observations from the CCMI nursery, including health state, genotype and placement on nursery frames, with the repository README.

title: Caribbean seagrass thermal performance
paper_relationship_status: Probable match to the CCMI publication; repository does not explicitly cite the paper DOI. Steward confirmation required.
description: Gross primary productivity, respiration, photosynthesis measurements, model parameters and R Markdown analyses for Caribbean seagrass thermal-performance experiments.
location: Caribbean; exact sampling sites require confirmation

title: Pickle Bank mesophotic reef fish communities
description: Fish-community observations and R Markdown analysis for the study of depth partitioning on Pickle Bank seamount.

title: Grand Cayman fish communities during COVID restrictions
description: Reef-fish survey observations, passenger-vessel data, site-coordinate table and sequential R scripts for the Grand Cayman human-confinement study.

title: Little Cayman benthic and reef-fish monitoring, 1999–2023
paper_relationship_status: No paper DOI is supplied in the repository README; publication association requires confirmation.
description: AGRRA algae, corals, fish and recruitment tables, source workbooks, staged tidy datasets and sequential R analyses. Raw, intermediate and analysis-ready directories are preserved as distinct file paths.

title: Microbial and visual indicators of white-band disease
description: The published Schul2023 code archive, its commit-pinned individual R scripts and 2019 coral-microbiome sequencing runs. Raw data and code are separately linked within the study.
